extName.description: Extension name, shown in the browser and the store listing.

extDescription.message: Resolve a DOI straight from the search box: DOI-only searches go to the DOI resolver instead of a page of search results.
extDescription.description: Extension description, shown in the browser and the store listing.

optionsTitle.description: Heading at the top of the settings page.

localePicker.description: Tooltip on the globe next to the language picker.

localeAuto.description: First entry of the language picker: follow the browser's own language.

masterSwitch.description: Label next to the on/off checkbox.

masterSwitchHint.message: Turn the extension off without uninstalling it.
masterSwitchHint.description: One line under the on/off checkbox.

customHint.message: Added engines need permission for that one site. Nothing else is requested.
customHint.description: One line explaining that a custom engine asks for one site only.

fieldName.description: Form label for the engine's display name.

fieldNamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the name box. An example the reader will recognise.

fieldHost.description: Form label for the engine's domain, e.g. search.example.edu.

fieldPath.description: Form label for the URL path, e.g. /query.

fieldParam.description: Form label for the query parameter name, e.g. q.

fieldParamPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the query parameter box.

add.description: Button that adds a custom search engine.

invalidEngine.message: Host and search parameter are required.
invalidEngine.description: Shown when host or search parameter is missing; also the empty preview.

engineExists.message: That search engine is already in the list.
engineExists.description: Shown when the engine being added is already in the list.

permissionDenied.message: Permission for that site was not granted, so the engine was not added.
permissionDenied.description: Shown when the user refuses the host permission for a custom engine.

noCustom.description: Empty-state line when no custom engine has been added.

resolverHint.message: The DOI is appended to this base URL as a path.
resolverHint.description: One line explaining that the DOI is appended to this base as a path.

resolverBase.description: Form label for the resolver base URL.

resolverInvalid.message: Must be an http(s) URL with no query string or fragment.
resolverInvalid.description: Error shown when the resolver base is not usable.

patternLabel.description: Form label for the DOI matching pattern.

patternHint.message: The regular expression matched against the search content. A leading doi: is stripped before matching, upper or lower case.
patternHint.description: Explains the one behaviour of the matcher that the regex itself does not perform and that the examples cannot show.

testLabel.description: Form label for the free-text box that tests the pattern.

testInputPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the free-text test box. Instruction, not an example value.

testMatch.description: Shown when the tested text matches the pattern.

testNoMatch.description: Shown when the tested text does not match the pattern.

patternInvalid.message: That is not a valid regular expression.
patternInvalid.description: Error shown when the pattern is not a valid JavaScript regular expression.

restoreDefault.description: Button that puts one setting back to its default.

examplesAccept.description: Heading over the example queries that should match.

examplesReject.description: Heading over the example queries that should not match.

popupOn.description: Popup status line while redirecting is on.

popupOff.description: Popup status line while redirecting is paused.

popupEngines.description: Popup line before the number of enabled engines.

openOptions.description: Popup button that opens the settings page.
